topic: Data correction for device session records
summary_markdown: The conversation addressed data issues related to device sessions. It was noted that scripts may have failed due to an update, resulting in only the `device_session` table being updated. A specific task was assigned to correct sensor data that was incorrectly logged to one facility and needed to be moved to another facility.
decisions: A task will be created to move sensor data from an incorrect facility to the proper facility.
action_items: Someone needs to update the device session scripts/data today.
